hints.title: Frequency Observation
hints.text: Every number appears either once or twice.

hints.title: Duplicate Identification
hints.text: Maintain a frequency map or seen set to detect when a number is encountered for the second time.

hints.title: Cumulative Bitwise XOR
hints.text: Accumulate each twice-appearing value into a running bitwise bitwise xor accumulator.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; linear pass is optimal.
